from PIL import Image
import numpy as np

img = Image.open('artifacts/fig1_main_v5_cropped.png')
arr = np.array(img)[:, :, :3]  # ignore alpha if present
h, w = arr.shape[:2]
print(f'Image: {w}x{h}')

# Background color: sample corners to estimate
bg_samples = [arr[0,0], arr[0,-1], arr[-1,0], arr[-1,-1]]
bg = np.mean(bg_samples, axis=0)
print(f'Estimated background: {bg}')

# Find content bounding box with threshold
# Consider a pixel as 'content' if it differs from bg by > threshold
threshold = 15

diff = np.abs(arr.astype(float) - bg.astype(float)).max(axis=2)
content_mask = diff > threshold

# Find bounding box
rows_with_content = np.where(content_mask.any(axis=1))[0]
cols_with_content = np.where(content_mask.any(axis=0))[0]

top = rows_with_content[0]
bottom = rows_with_content[-1]
left = cols_with_content[0]
right = cols_with_content[-1]

print(f'Content bounding box:')
print(f'  Top: row {top} ({top/h*100:.1f}%)')
print(f'  Bottom: row {bottom} ({bottom/h*100:.1f}%), bottom margin: {h-1-bottom} rows ({(h-1-bottom)/h*100:.1f}%)')
print(f'  Left: col {left} ({left/w*100:.1f}%)')
print(f'  Right: col {right} ({right/w*100:.1f}%), right margin: {w-1-right} cols')

# Convert to PDF points (at 300 DPI: 1px = 72/300 pts = 0.24pts)
dpi = 300
px_to_pt = 72.0 / dpi
print(f'\\nIn PDF points:')
print(f'  Top margin: {top * px_to_pt:.1f}pt')
print(f'  Bottom margin: {(h-1-bottom) * px_to_pt:.1f}pt')
print(f'  Left margin: {left * px_to_pt:.1f}pt')
print(f'  Right margin: {(w-1-right) * px_to_pt:.1f}pt')

# Also check with a more aggressive threshold
threshold2 = 8
diff2 = np.abs(arr.astype(float) - bg.astype(float)).max(axis=2)
content_mask2 = diff2 > threshold2
rows2 = np.where(content_mask2.any(axis=1))[0]
print(f'\\nWith threshold={threshold2}:')
print(f'  First content row: {rows2[0]}, last: {rows2[-1]}')
print(f'  Top margin: {rows2[0] * px_to_pt:.1f}pt, bottom margin: {(h-1-rows2[-1]) * px_to_pt:.1f}pt')
"
